evaluation_target: CTU-13 Scenario 10 (Rbot Volumetric UDP & ICMP Flood Storm)
findings: Scenario 10 exhibits severe Out-of-Distribution (OOD) shift due to volumetric storm flooding. Linear classifiers fail on OOD shifts (F1=0.0) as flood features oppose stealthy IRC scan signatures. However, nonlinear Random Forest achieved ROC-AUC=0.540, PR-AUC=0.444. World Model forecasting maintained stable bounded predictions across all horizons.
